entries.summary: Bright blue above with whitish gray belly and chin, a gray-blue feather crest that can be raised or lowered, bright blue wings and tail banded white and black, and a black collar across the throat and around the head. Bill, legs, feet, and eyes are black. Males are just slightly larger than females on average.
